De acordo com relatórios publicados pela NASA News, os novos dados confirmam: NASA and its international partners are set to receive scientific research samples and hardware as a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft departs the International Space Station no earlier than Wednesday, Nov. 18, for its return to Earth. Pending weather conditions, the Dragon spacecraft will undock from the Harmony module’s space-facing port at 11:05 a.
